claims.text: The hotel sits in the center of the historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, a short stroll from the city's monuments.

findings.quote: With a thrilling landmark position in the center of the historic Dupont Circle neighborhood and a short stroll from the city's most iconic monuments

claims.text: Dupont Circle is a stylish diplomatic neighborhood.

findings.quote: Nestled in Dupont Circle, a stylish diplomatic neighborhood

claims.text: The hotel is less than a two-minute walk from the Dupont Circle Metro Station.

findings.quote: The property is less than a two-minute stroll from the Dupont Circle Metro Station

claims.text: The design blends contemporary comfort with a mid-century aesthetic that pays homage to the building's beginnings.

findings.quote: seamlessly weaves contemporary comfort and style with a mid-century aesthetic that pays homage to the building’s beginnings

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites blend art-forward design with modern comforts.

findings.quote:
The Dupont Circle offers spacious
guest rooms and
suites across nine floors that seamlessly blend art-forward design with modern comforts

claims.text: The ninth-floor penthouse level is reached by a private elevator.

findings.quote: On the ninth-floor penthouse level, accessible via a private elevator

claims.text: The lobby has space to work or read by the fireplace.

findings.quote: There’s ample space for setting up shop to work, read a book by the fireplace, or meet a friend for coffee.

claims.text: Nightly turndown service and room service are available.

findings.quote: More available in-room amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, nightly turndown service, dry cleaning and laundry services, and room service.

claims.text: Service centers on welcoming Irish hospitality.

findings.quote: welcoming Irish hospitality at the forefront of The Dupont Circle’s service

claims.text: The hotel is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned hotel group.

findings.quote: The Dupont Circle is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group

claims.text: Doyle Bar has views of Dupont Circle and nods to the cocktail culture of the 1950s and 60s.

findings.quote: Featuring sweeping views of Dupont Circle alongside warm wood paneling, soft jewel-toned banquettes and vibrant artwork, the bar effortlessly nods to the cocktail culture of the 1950s and 60s.

claims.text: Doyle Bar has a collection of Irish whiskeys.

findings.quote: This beautiful Washington, D.C. bar also boasts an impressive collection of Irish whiskeys

claims.text: Suites with private furnished terraces have panoramic city views from the Washington Monument to the National Cathedral.

findings.quote: Suites with private, furnished terraces offer incomparable panoramic city views, stretching from the Washington Monument to the National Cathedral.

claims.text: The Grand Penthouse was designed by Irish-born designer Clodagh and has five private heated terraces.

findings.quote: the Grand Penthouse, designed by Irish-born and internationally acclaimed Clodagh, is one of Washington D.C.’s largest suites and features five private heated terraces

claims.text: The hotel was refurbished in collaboration with designers Martin Brudnizki and Clodagh.

findings.quote: Following a transformative refurbishment in collaboration with world-renowned designers Martin Brudnizki and Clodagh

claims.text: Bathrooms have marble tiles, heated floors and Malin + Goetz bath products.

findings.quote: the spa-like bathroom with marble tiles, heated floors, plush bathrobes, and Malin + Goetz bath products

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that nothing about the elegant, upscale property feels overly family-friendly.

findings.quote: there isn’t anything about the elegant and upscale property that feels overly family-friendly

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in a busy urban setting.
